validation.disclaimer: Flags request human review; they are not proof of hallucination. Passing all checks does not prove correctness.

correct_findings: The model correctly identified a Linux system startup sequence and attributed the hostname to combo and the log source to syslog. It recognized routine kernel initialization, memory configuration, and service startup events. No confirmed malicious activity was established in the selected evidence.
incorrect_findings: The model continued to mention possible unauthorized BIOS modification and privilege escalation based on E003 despite no supporting evidence. It incorrectly suggested a machine check event on CPU#0 although E009 only records that machine check reporting was enabled. The timeline contained placeholder rows and incorrectly placed the hostname in the Source column. The report also exposed internal feedback lesson identifiers.
missing_evidence: Evidence of actual BIOS modification or privilege escalation
Evidence of a CPU machine check error
hallucinations: Unsupported BIOS modification and privilege escalation speculation
Unsupported interpretation of enabled CPU machine check reporting as a possible machine check event
review.notes: LT-04 post-feedback-v2 evaluation. Analysis AN-20261019-014603-c434 demonstrated improved hostname attribution and recognition of routine Linux initialization. However, the model continued to introduce unsupported BIOS security speculation and incorrectly interpreted CPU machine check reporting as a possible machine check event. The automated validator detected one incomplete timeline issue but did not flag these additional semantic problems. Further deterministic validation and behavioral grounding are required. Human Review Status: Corrected.
